predictor.notes: Best-effort predictor, not a uniquely recovered exact rule. Used 24 business requests and 9 REA operations, including inspection. Approved responses supplied exact prices of 101100 cents at quantity 50 and 364800 cents at quantity 200; the first segment matches both exactly. All other observed responses were rounded to 100000 cents. The predictor is consistent with every observed response under nearest-100000-cent rounding. Adjacent observations at 571 and 572 establish a sharp price drop there, represented by the segment boundary. The lower-quantity quadratic and higher-quantity linear coefficients are estimates: the coarse responses do not identify exact coefficients or exclude additional pricing bands. Unobserved prices remain uncertain, particularly in the second segment.
